info.name: Gladia Control AudioToText Job History API
Get the history of all your jobs

params.name: offset
params.description: The starting point for pagination. A value of 0 starts from the first item.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. Useful for pagination and controlling data payload size.

params.name: date
params.description: Filter items relevant to a specific date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: before_date
params.description: Include items that occurred before the specified date in ISO format.

params.name: after_date
params.description: Filter for items after the specified date. Use with `before_date` for a range. Date in ISO format.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter the list based on item status. Accepts multiple values from the predefined list.

params.name: kind
params.description: Filter the list based on the item type. Supports multiple values from the predefined list.

items.docs: Get the history of all your jobs
